ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) localized peaks appearing as discrete circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark contiguous pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white circular focal spots are mapped primarily at the distal tips and along the upper trailing edges, with specific dense clusters located at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by multiple jagged peaks and valleys with a significant macro-notch indentation on the proximal-inner section of the right lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curves originating from the peduncle and terminating in sharp, dorsally-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white) concentrated on the distal margins and tips of both lobes, appearing as individual rosettes and fused clusters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned light-colored linear disruptions visible on the mid-left lobe and several horizontal marks near the center-right transition area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive circular white scarring at the lobe tips typical of barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique step-like indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
